options.text: Rectangle $KLMJ$ is valid: it lists corners in boundary travel order, starting at $K$.
Rectangle $JLKM$, listing corners by jumping across instead of travelling the boundary.
Only rectangle $JKLM$ is allowed; starting at any other corner makes the name invalid.
Rectangle $JKLM$ is valid only after renaming the corners in alphabetical order first.

stem:
Falguni labels the corners of a rectangle $J$, $K$, $L$, $M$ in order going around the boundary. A valid name may start at any corner and then follow that travel order.

Which name is valid for that rectangle?

teacher.key_rationale: KLMJ follows boundary order from K. JLKM jumps a diagonal; insisting on only JKLM omits that any start is allowed; alphabetical renaming is unrelated.
